reason: The README describes a cross-session persistent memory plugin that stores bounded plaintext notes and user profiles, injects snapshots into prompts, and optionally performs isolated background memory reviews.

summaries.zh: 用于在会话之间持久保存有限长度的纯文本笔记和用户画像，并将记忆快照注入智能体上下文。
summaries.en: A plugin for persisting bounded plain-text notes and user profiles across sessions and injecting memory snapshots into the agent context.

capabilities: persists plain-text memory and user-profile entries to local files
provides tools to add, replace, remove, batch-edit, view, and refresh memory
injects frozen memory snapshots into system prompts
periodically uses an isolated subagent to review recent user messages and update memory
can deliver memory update notifications through the agent inbox
